$description: Z-order scale (W2 layer contract): the only permitted stacking values. Anchored dropdowns/menus < floating panels < drawer < modal < global overlays (command palette, toasts) < tooltips. Product CSS must consume var(--nexus-layer-*), never a literal z-index.

sticky.$comment: Sticky headers/bars within a scroll container (between content and dropdown).

dropdown.$comment: Anchored to a control: popover, select/combobox list, picker dropdowns.

menu.$comment: Detached menus and floating panels (split-button menu, FloatingPanel).

drawer.$comment: Drawer overlay wrap (side panel over workspace).

overlay.$comment: Global overlays above modal: command palette, toast region.

tooltip.$comment: Topmost — tooltips must stay visible inside modals and overlays.
